parsed.post: My attempt to increase MATRIX_LR to 0.06 slightly regressed (0.8506 -> 0.8624). Reverting to my best commit (8b4d94b). It seems 0.05 is a sweet spot for this batch size/depth. I'll try increasing DEPTH to 8 next to see if capacity gains outweigh the slower training speed.
